==Information==
===Format===
====Regular Season====
*The league is made of 8 teams of 4 players, where 3 of the 4 players are selected each week to participate in team battles
*In each battle one team is the home team and the other the away team
**The away team must declare the player order and character selection before the battle begins
**The home team is able to choose the players and character selection as the battle progresses

*Battles consist of consecutive matches with each being scored with the following format:

{| class="wikitable" style="width:500px;text-align:center;"
! Matches 
! Games
! Points
|-
| 1st Match || {{Abbr/Bo3}} || +10 PTS
|-
| 2nd Match || {{Abbr/Bo3}} || +10 PTS
|-
| 3rd Match || {{Abbr/Bo5}} || +20 PTS
|-
| Tie Breaker || {{Abbr/Bo1}} || +5 PTS
|}

*Top 5 teams advance to the next stage
**The 1st place team directly qualifies to the Grand Finals
**The 2nd to 5th teams advance to the Playoffs

====Playoffs & Grand Finals====
*Head-to-head team matchups determined based on each team's Regular Season placements
*Winner qualifies to the [[Street_Fighter_League/World_Championship/2022|Street Fighter League World Championship 2022]]
